description: Start a saved-site audit; consumes allowance. wait:true waits up to 90 seconds and may still return pollAfterMs; poll get_audit_status for up to 3 minutes. Use quick for iteration and full for comprehensive evidence. Use audit_url only for performance on unsaved URLs. For deployed HTML/robots/canonical/noindex, use get_seo_evidence with refresh:true, scope:'page', sources:['page']. audit_url does not prove indexing; use get_seo_evidence refresh:true sources:['indexing'].

siteId.description: Saved site ID from list_sites or add_site; not a URL

strategy.description: 'quick' for faster iteration; 'full' for the comprehensive audit data

wait.description: Set true to wait up to 90 seconds for completion. Structured content includes compact reportSummary evidence when the stored report is ready. Defaults to false.

name: run_audit

reportSummary.description: Schema-validated summary projection from get_audit_report: measured metrics and provenance, leading evidence, bounded actions, warnings and limitations. Present only in structured content when a completed report is available.

summary.description: Present on complete; saved prose or measured metrics

trustBoundary.description: How clients must treat report text carried only in structured content

title: Run a Saved Site Check
